This? ``` INFO [06-08|13:46:39.069] Initialised chain configuration config="{ChainID: 123 Homestead: 0 DAO: <nil> DAOSupport: false EIP150: 0 EIP155: 0 EIP158: 0 Byzantium: 0 Constantinople: 0 Petersburg: 0 Istanbul : 0, Muir Glacier: <nil>, Berlin: 0, YOLO v3: <nil>, Engine: clique}" ``` what's your `geth version`? Built from master, but: ``` $ ./build/bin/geth version Geth Version: 1.10.4-unstable Git Commit: c503f98f6d5e80e079c1d8a3601d188af2a899da Git Commit Date: 20210608 Architecture: amd64 Go Version: go1.14.7 Operating System: linux GOPATH=/home/fvictorio/.go GOROOT=go ``` how are you instantiating geth? you shouldn't be seeing `YOLO v3`, that makes me think you're calling an old executable there Ugh Yeah, I'm an idiot, sorry I was using the globally installed one Now it works, thank you and sorry for wasting your time 😅 haha all good, many times i've pulled out my hair over the same thing I found a tiny difference between nethermind and our JSON-RPC regarding eip-1559 transactions. No, they should not be allowed Got it, that's my intuition too 🙂 Geth rejects all transactions where feecap is smaller than tip, but nethermind turns them into legacy tx's Ah, got it. Doesn't Nethermind's behavior contradict the constraint we added to the EIP in the last ACD? ``` require(maxFeePerGas >= maxPriorityFeePerGas) # Makes sense that the total is larger than a part thereof ``` It should, but the others don't reject the transactions either It's super weird I'm probably wrong about something here Yeah, or the teams didn't update their implementation yet, but you would hope they did before joining Calaveras 😅 Nah, my local node is updated and it verifies the blocks too yeah, and this seems merged in Nethermind: https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/3090 Same for Besu: https://github.com/hyperledger/besu/pull/2338/files Hmm now I can't repro it anymore Nethermind still seems to accept transactions like this over RPC: ``` tip := new(big.Int).Mul(big.NewInt(100), big.NewInt(params.GWei)) feecap := new(big.Int).Mul(big.NewInt(1), big.NewInt(params.GWei)) tx := randomTx(f, nonce, price) tx = to1559Tx(tx, chainid, tip, feecap, price) ``` but they are not mined afaict. Still they should be rejected by the RPC

I found a tiny difference between nethermind and our JSON-RPC regarding eip-1559 transactions. 
We reject a transaction with negative fee cap while nethermind turns it into a legacy transaction with the gas price set to tip
